About.intro1: V.N.S. Engineering Hydraulic Co., Ltd. (VNS HYDRAULIC ENGINEERING) was founded in 1999.
About.intro2: The company specializes in hydraulic engineering and industrial parts manufacturing, starting from a machining shop focused on producing high-quality fittings in stainless steel, iron, and brass to meet the needs of leading industrial clients.
About.intro3: With over 20 years of experience, the company has grown into a full-service industrial hose system distributor and service provider, covering sourcing, design, and custom hose assembly.
About.service1: Manufacturing all types of HOSE FITTINGS in Stainless Steel, Iron and Brass
About.service2: Sales and assembly of HYDRAULIC HOSE
About.service3: Sales and assembly of STAINLESS STEEL FLEXIBLE HOSE
About.service4: Sales and assembly of PTFE HOSE
About.visionText: To be the leading provider of complete industrial hose and hydraulic systems, trusted by customers for quality and service.
About.mission1: Develop products and services to meet industry standards

HydraulicHose.bullet1: Inner and outer tube made from high-quality synthetic rubber
HydraulicHose.bullet2_1SN: Reinforced with one layer of hard-drawn steel wire braid with protective coating
HydraulicHose.bullet2_2SN: Reinforced with two layers of hard-drawn steel wire braid with protective coating
HydraulicHose.bullet2_4SP: Reinforced with 4 spiral layers of high-tensile steel wire with protective coating
HydraulicHose.bullet2_4SH: Reinforced with 4 heavy spiral layers of high-tensile steel wire for extra-high pressure
HydraulicHose.bullet3: Excellent resistance to abrasion and weathering
HydraulicHose.bullet4: Temperature range: -40°C to +100°C, peak +125°C for short periods
HydraulicHose.bullet5: Suitable for conveying hydraulic oils, mineral oils, emulsions, water, and water-glycol solutions

PTFESmooth.bullet1: Highly chemical resistant → compatible with almost all acids, alkalis, and solvents
PTFESmooth.bullet2: Non-absorbent / Non-contaminating (NON-CONTAMINATION) → safe for food & pharmaceutical use
PTFESmooth.bullet3: Very smooth inner surface (LOW FRICTION) → reduces clogging
PTFESmooth.bullet4: UV / ozone resistant — does not degrade easily
PTFESmooth.highlight: Key advantage: handles both extreme heat AND extreme cold in one hose

PTFEConvoluted.intro: PTFE CONVOLUTED hose is widely used in high-end industrial applications because it combines "flexibility + chemical resistance + high heat resistance"
PTFEConvoluted.feature1: Corrugated (CORRUGATED) structure → bends more easily than smooth bore PTFE hose
PTFEConvoluted.feature3: Resistant to almost all chemicals (acids, alkalis, solvents)
PTFEConvoluted.feature4: Non-reactive with fluids → suitable for FOOD / PHARMA
PTFEConvoluted.feature5: UV / ozone resistant — does not degrade easily
PTFEConvoluted.feature6: Available in ANTISTATIC version to prevent static electricity

StainlessFlexibleIntro.badge: Stainless Steel Flexible Hose (SS Flexible Hose)
StainlessFlexibleIntro.description: Flexible Hose (Flex Hose) is highly flexible with up to 360° bend capability, made from materials such as stainless steel (SUS304, 316) or PVC with spring wire reinforcement

R7Hose.description: Medium pressure hose (70-210 bar) with thermoplastic inner tube reinforced by synthetic fiber braid and abrasion-resistant outer cover (MSHA approved). Suitable for hydraulic oil, water, and general use. Highly flexible, lightweight, temperature rated -40°C to +100°C.

SteamHose.intro: STEAM HOSE is an industrial hose designed specifically for steam applications, requiring resistance to high heat, high pressure, and moisture. Key features:
SteamHose.bullet1: High heat resistance: continuous operation at ~170-210°C (peak slightly higher)
SteamHose.bullet2: Pressure rated: typically 10-20 BAR (burst pressure ~3-4x working pressure)
SteamHose.bullet3: 3-layer construction: EPDM rubber + wire/fabric reinforcement + weather-resistant outer cover
SteamHose.bullet4: Resistant to steam, hot water, moisture, and heat degradation
SteamHose.bullet5: Environmental resistance: ozone, UV, and abrasion resistant
SteamHose.bullet6: Good flexibility, but do not exceed minimum bend radius
SteamHose.bullet7: Suitable for BOILER systems, food processing, chemical cleaning, and steam washing
SteamHose.bullet8: High safety focus — must use correct fittings and specifications

Toyox.description: PVC reinforced spiral hose, temperature rated -5°C to 60°C. Suitable for air, oil, chemicals, plastic pellet conveying, gas, spray painting, food-grade applications, industrial use, suction and discharge, multipurpose, gas/chemical/oil resistant. Material: PVC with polyester yarn braid reinforcement. Many options available for various applications.

OSD150.h3: Oil Suction/Discharge Hose (OIL SUCTION/DISCHARGE HOSE) 150 PSI
OSD150.description: For use with oil tankers and tank trucks for oil suction and discharge. Full vacuum rated. Compatible with petroleum products with up to 50% aromatic content.

AH300.h3: Air/Water Industrial Hose, 300 PSI Working Pressure
AH300.description: Suitable for both air and water. Strong construction, abrasion resistant, oil mist resistant, excellent weather resistance. Ideal for heavy industry, construction sites, and mining.

CSD150.h3: Cement/Sand Suction & Discharge Hose, 150 PSI Working Pressure
CSD150.description: Designed for heavy-duty applications with abrasive materials such as cement, sand, gravel, and other dry materials. Black abrasion-resistant inner rubber with synthetic fiber and spiral wire reinforcement for excellent vacuum resistance.

WSD150.h3: Water Suction & Discharge Hose, 150 PSI Working Pressure
WSD150.description: Suitable for wastewater, sewage, mud, and general liquids with pH 5-8. Strong synthetic fiber and wire reinforcement. Excellent abrasion and weather resistance.
WSD150.bullet3: Full vacuum and 150 PSI working pressure rated

DH300.description: Designed for heavy-duty dock and marine applications. Rated to 300 PSI and +100°C. Excellent resistance to abrasion, oil, ozone, and weathering.
DH300.bullet3: Application: Dock & Offshore (ships and port facilities)

BallValve.description: HYDRAULIC BALL VALVE is a flow control device (primarily for hydraulic oil) that withstands high pressure, is easy to operate with a tight seal, and is used across many industries.
BallValve.feature4: Durable construction with long service life

Camlock.description: Also known as a "lever-type quick connector" — designed for fast, safe connections without special tools. Widely used in fluid transfer across all industries.
Camlock.feature1: Connect and disconnect quickly with fingertip ease
Camlock.feature2: Dense locking system — excellent leak prevention
Camlock.feature3: Multiple types available (Type A, B, C, D, E, F, DC, DP)
Camlock.feature4: Durable for heavy use and a wide range of chemicals

QuickCoupling.feature1: Quick connect and disconnect — no tools required
QuickCoupling.feature2: Reduces downtime and improves system efficiency
QuickCoupling.feature3: Automatic locking mechanism — prevents accidental disconnection
QuickCoupling.feature5: Handles both low and high pressure (model dependent)
QuickCoupling.feature6: Multiple materials: stainless steel, steel, brass
QuickCoupling.feature7: Compatible with various fluids: water, air, oil, and chemicals
